issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: Minnesota Woman Convicted in $3.6M Scheme to Defraud Medicaid Housing Services Program
notes: Source-level capture from official government release on November 1, 2026. Multiple legal stages are separately described and must not be collapsed. Source status follows existing live corpus records.
supports: A jury convicted Sharmaine Meadows on October 7, 2026, on three counts of health-care fraud concerning Housing Stabilization Services.
DOJ describes more than $3.6 million paid to her company between 2020 and 2025.
The October 8 release states that sentencing will take place later.
does_not_support: A sentencing judgment or restitution collected from Meadows.
